title: Cluster OTA status badge, application contracts and OTA update verification measures
references: Tailored from Automotive SPICE 4.0 (SWE.4-6, SUP.1/8/9), ISO 26262-6 verification structure and UN R156 software-update concepts. Not a compliance claim.

measures.title: Stable application shows STABLE and the stable SW version
measures.method: automated unit test of decide()/read_snapshot()
measures.precondition: slot journal phase=stable, selector on the stable slot
measures.expected: state=stable, version=stable_version, or initial version when the provisioned slot has none
measures.pass_fail: PASS if every listed case passes; any other state/version is FAIL

measures.title: Running trial slot shows OTA TRIAL and the trial SW version from app launch
measures.iso26262_6: Software unit verification; software integration verification
measures.method: automated unit tests and real A/B slot lifecycle
measures.precondition: trial slot selected (phase activating after selector switch, or trial)
measures.expected: state=trial, version=trial_version at the ExecStartPre snapshot of the restart
measures.pass_fail: PASS if the trial is reported at the restart snapshot itself; reporting stable before the switch is required

measures.title: After commit the display becomes STABLE with the new version without an application restart
measures.iso26262_6: Software integration and verification; testing of the embedded software (simulated)
measures.method: real slot lifecycle + full zonal OTA path (TLS, CAN, coordinator)
measures.precondition: trial 1.1.1 active; vehicle verification passes; coordinator commits
measures.expected: display sequence stable 1.0.0 -> trial 1.1.1 -> stable 1.1.1; no restored mark; app restarted only once (activation)
measures.pass_fail: PASS only for the exact sequence and COMMITTED coordinator phase

measures.title: After rollback the display returns to the previous stable version and briefly shows RESTORED
measures.method: real slot lifecycle + full zonal path with injected runtime defect; Qt boundary tests for the 15 s window
measures.precondition: trial 1.1.1 on screen; whole-vehicle rollback restores A
measures.expected: display returns to stable 1.0.0 with restored_at set; RESTORED shown for <15 s, then STABLE; commit and staged abort never set it
measures.pass_fail: PASS if the restored mark appears only for the visible trial->previous-version transition

measures.title: Corrupt, missing, partial or inconsistent metadata shows UNKNOWN and never crashes
measures.method: automated fault-injection unit tests (helper); Qt unit tests (app model)
measures.precondition: status inputs: corrupt/partial/empty journal, missing journal or selector, foreign selector, journal/selector mismatch, invalid versions, interrupted output write
measures.expected: helper publishes unknown/null; previous status stays intact on an interrupted write; no exception escapes
measures.pass_fail: PASS if every partition yields unknown (never a guessed version) and no crash

measures.title: Qt AppStatus model and badge fail closed and propagate properties (Qt 5.15 build)
measures.method: Qt Test (38 cases) and QML TestCase (14 cases) built with a real Qt 5.15.2 toolchain
measures.precondition: CAPSTONE_QT_DIR points at a Qt 5.15 prefix
measures.expected: all Qt unit and QML component cases pass
measures.pass_fail: PASS if both Qt binaries report 0 failures; NOT_EXECUTED without a Qt toolchain

measures.title: The privileged slot journal is never exposed to the Cluster application
measures.method: system test over the full OTA path + deployment asset inspection
measures.precondition: full rollback lifecycle; production unit files
measures.expected: state.json stays 0600; status file has only 4 display keys and mode 0644; app unit gains no ReadWritePaths; snapshot drops root via setpriv to capstone-ota; watcher runs as capstone-ota; planted symlink/FIFO never followed
measures.pass_fail: PASS if no OTA identifier/digest leaks and no privilege is widened

measures.title: A status-display failure never blocks the Cluster application or the OTA services
measures.method: automated tests of snapshot/watch failure handling + unit file contract
measures.precondition: missing output directory, unwritable output, corrupt journal during watch
measures.expected: snapshot exits 0; watch keeps polling; ExecStartPre uses '-' so the app still starts
measures.pass_fail: PASS if no failure mode propagates to the application start or the watch loop

measures.title: Badge keeps the original cluster usable on the desktop x86_64 capture: no upstream content under the plate (one reviewed decorative overlap), legible, never red, no input capture
measures.iso26262_6: Testing of the embedded software (desktop, not target)
measures.method: static checks, clearance/coverage unit tests, and the desktop capture of the real patched app vs the unpatched baseline in 11 layouts (Qt 5.15.2 x86_64, Xvfb)
measures.precondition: patched upstream built with Qt 5.15.2 on x86_64, run under Xvfb
measures.expected: baseline content under the 124x50 plate = 0 px and >=2 px left clearance in every layout except the reviewed decorative frame line of OriginalEarly240Layout; capture evidence matches the current badge sources
measures.pass_fail: PASS if static/unit cases pass and the committed capture evidence reports failed=false, baseline_compared=true and source hashes equal the current files

measures.title: Customization is reproducible on the pinned upstream and preserves provenance
measures.method: patch/apply-script tests; opt-in application to a real pinned import
measures.expected: add-only patch touching exactly 4 files; apply refuses non-imports and re-application
measures.pass_fail: PASS if static cases pass; opt-in case NOT_EXECUTED without an import

measures.title: The patch applies to a real pinned upstream import and refuses re-application
measures.method: opt-in test against a real import of commit 79345291
measures.expected: apply exits 0 with marker and overlay files; second apply exits non-zero 'already applied'
measures.pass_fail: PASS if both apply outcomes match; NOT_EXECUTED without an import

measures.title: Software versions before and after an update are identifiable on the vehicle
measures.method: existing heartbeat tests + UI status tests
measures.expected: heartbeat and UI report the running version in each state; provisioned version protected from downgrade
measures.pass_fail: PASS if every listed case passes

measures.title: The trial software version equals the signed vehicle bundle target and the bundle cannot be altered
r156_concepts: R156: authenticity and integrity of the update
measures.method: system test comparing displayed trial version with the signed bundle; existing signature tests
measures.expected: displayed trial version == signed target; modified bundle rejected
measures.pass_fail: PASS if versions match exactly and tampering is rejected

measures.title: A runtime semantic incompatibility rolls back both ECUs (whole-vehicle)
r156_concepts: R156: dependencies between updated systems verified
measures.method: full zonal path with an injected Cluster speed-scale defect (speed_divisor=10)
measures.precondition: both trial apps active, protocol declarations compatible
measures.expected: FUNCTIONAL_VALUE_MISMATCH detected; Central and Cluster return to slot A; display 1.1.1 -> 1.0.0
measures.pass_fail: PASS only if the defect is detected by functional verification and both ECUs are restored

measures.title: ROLLED_BACK is reported only after recovery verification passes; failed recovery is never a success
r156_concepts: R156: previous software version restoration verified
measures.method: existing coordinator/compatibility tests + system test evidence
measures.expected: recovery verification (heartbeats + functional) passed before ROLLED_BACK; otherwise RECOVERY_FAILED
measures.pass_fail: PASS if no path reports ROLLED_BACK without passing recovery verification

measures.title: Power interruption during verification recovers the previous version set after boot
measures.method: existing and new power-loss tests over the full zonal path
measures.precondition: power cut in VERIFYING with both trials active
measures.expected: boot recovery -> ROLLED_BACK (UPDATE_INTERRUPTED), recovery verification passed, display stable 1.0.0
measures.pass_fail: PASS if both ECUs return to A and recovery verification passed

measures.title: Tampered artifacts and invalid signatures are rejected before any slot changes
r156_concepts: R156: authenticity and integrity of the update
measures.method: existing tests: tampered archive, equal-length hash mismatch, forged signature
measures.precondition: artifact or signature modified after signing
measures.expected: ABORTED / SIGNATURE_INVALID; no slot or journal change
measures.pass_fail: PASS if every manipulation is rejected before staging

measures.title: Declared configuration incompatibility (CAN protocol major, dependencies, target) is rejected before activation
r156_concepts: R156: compatibility with target HW/SW configuration
measures.method: existing static compatibility tests
measures.precondition: bundle declares protocol_major 2 or unsatisfied dependency or wrong target
measures.expected: ABORTED before activation; slots unchanged
measures.pass_fail: PASS if no incompatible bundle reaches activation

measures.title: Cluster heartbeat loss after activation causes whole-vehicle rollback
measures.method: existing heartbeat-loss scenario + CAN freshness unit tests
measures.expected: ROLLED_BACK with HEARTBEAT_* or PROCESS_UNHEALTHY; Cluster on slot A
measures.pass_fail: PASS if loss is detected and rolled back

measures.title: Update results are recorded durably and repeated commands return the recorded result
measures.method: existing coordinator/slot idempotency tests
measures.expected: recorded outcome and evidence returned; no reinstall
measures.pass_fail: PASS if replays never change state

measures.title: Downgrade to an equal or older release is rejected (anti-rollback)
r156_concepts: R156: protection against unauthorized/unintended version change
measures.method: existing manifest/updater/zone-agent tests
measures.expected: rejected before download/staging
measures.pass_fail: PASS if every older/equal offer is rejected

measures.title: Existing least-privilege deployment assets remain intact
measures.method: existing asset tests
measures.expected: fixed paths, separate accounts, mTLS broker, zonal units unchanged in contract
measures.pass_fail: PASS if all existing asset tests pass

measures.title: On the two-Pi rig the Cluster display shows STABLE 1.0.0 -> OTA TRIAL 1.1.1 -> RESTORED/STABLE 1.0.0
measures.method: manual demonstration with video, candump and journal evidence (docs/RPI_VALIDATION_CHECKLIST.md)
measures.precondition: two Raspberry Pi 4B, MCP2515 CAN, Qt ARM build of the patched app
measures.expected: sequence visible on camera; journal and status file match
measures.pass_fail: PASS only with recorded hardware evidence

measures.title: On target hardware speed/RPM/gear/warning indicators behave exactly as before the patch
measures.method: manual side-by-side check against the unpatched build
measures.expected: identical gauge behaviour; badge does not cover lamps
measures.pass_fail: PASS only with recorded hardware evidence

measures.title: The patched app builds for the Pi (Qt/ARM) and the Qt tests pass on target
measures.method: cross/native build on the Pi
measures.expected: build succeeds; run-qt-tests.sh passes on target
measures.pass_fail: PASS only with recorded target build log

measures.title: Central publishes a valid 0x100 heartbeat every heartbeat period (1 s default)
measures.method: fake-clock unit tests and a wall-clock run of the real loop
measures.precondition: identity known; default or harness periods
measures.expected: 10 heartbeats in 10 s (fake clock); wall-clock median within ±20 % and no gap above 2× nominal; frames decode with the framework codec
measures.pass_fail: PASS if counts are exact and cadence is inside the acceptance band

measures.title: Central heartbeat version/state follow the active A/B application, never hard-coded
measures.method: identity partitions, re-read per heartbeat, and the real coordinator's heartbeat evidence
measures.expected: stable/trial map to STABLE/TRIAL with the slot version; unknown/missing/non-numeric suppress the heartbeat
measures.pass_fail: PASS if every partition maps as specified and the trial evidence expects 1.1.0

measures.title: Central heartbeat and vehicle counters are contiguous modulo 256 and do not burst after a stall
measures.method: fake-clock unit tests over 300 frames and a 5 s stall
measures.expected: every step +1 mod 256 through 255→0; one frame per stream after a stall
measures.pass_fail: PASS if no gap or duplicate occurs

measures.title: Central publishes deterministic in-contract vehicle status on 0x200 at the vehicle period (100 ms default)
measures.method: profile boundary tests, fake-clock counts, wall-clock cadence
measures.expected: 100 frames in 10 s; values at phase boundaries as specified and always inside CanContract
measures.pass_fail: PASS if values and counts are exact and cadence is inside the band

measures.title: Central maintenance IPC conforms to ApplicationIpc v1 and keeps CAN traffic flowing
measures.method: handler unit tests and the framework's own ApplicationIpc client against the running server
measures.precondition: server bound at a temporary path
measures.expected: maintenance on/off confirmed with the echoed request id; unknown operation REJECTED; heartbeats continue and vehicle output switches to the stationary profile
measures.pass_fail: PASS if the real client accepts every reply and traffic never stops

measures.title: Cluster vehicle IPC updates the real dashboard models the QML scene renders
measures.method: Qt unit tests on model property paths and the real patched binary driven by ApplicationIpc
measures.expected: vehicle sample written through speedoModel/rpmModel/lamp models; the following functional read-back reflects model state
measures.pass_fail: PASS if both Qt and real-binary cases pass; NOT_EXECUTED without Qt

measures.title: Cluster functional IPC returns the values the application actually interpreted
measures.method: real patched binary answering both probe challenges
measures.expected: (650,3000,D,1) and (0,800,P,0) read back exactly from the models
measures.pass_fail: PASS if results equal the interpreted model state

measures.title: The functional response is never a blind echo of the request
measures.method: Qt test with a clamping model (expects 500 for a 650 request) and the real fault binary (expects 65)
measures.expected: response follows model state, not the request; an echo mutant fails the test
measures.pass_fail: PASS if responses differ from the request exactly where the model differs

measures.title: Malformed, oversized, partial or silent IPC peers neither crash nor block either application
measures.method: Central handler partitions and live server, real Qt binary under garbage and silent clients
measures.expected: no response for malformed envelopes; other clients served within 1-1.5 s; silent peers dropped at the 2 s deadline; processes stay alive
measures.pass_fail: PASS if service continues in every case

measures.title: A DEMO/TEST fault build produces a real display/model mismatch that the validator reports as FUNCTIONAL_VALUE_MISMATCH
r156_concepts: R156: dependencies between updated systems verified
measures.method: real fault binary in Cluster slot B over the real zonal path
measures.expected: speedometer model holds 6.5 km/h; validator expects 650, observes 65; FUNCTIONAL_VALUE_MISMATCH
measures.pass_fail: PASS only if the mismatch comes from the real binary (a normal binary in its place makes the test fail)

measures.title: The normal application set passes trial verification and commits
measures.method: real Central + real Qt Cluster + real coordinator/zone agent; Central-only variant without Qt
measures.expected: COMMITTED; all functional checks passed; badge stable→trial; maintenance [on, off] via real IPC
measures.pass_fail: PASS if COMMITTED with every functional check passed

measures.title: A trial application failure rolls back the whole vehicle
measures.method: real fault binary; real Central with its identity removed during trial
measures.expected: ROLLED_BACK; both ECUs on slot A; the Cluster relaunched from slot A
measures.pass_fail: PASS if both ECUs are restored in both scenarios

measures.title: Recovery verification confirms the previous stable application set with the real applications
measures.method: recovery-scope evidence after rollback and after power loss
measures.expected: recovery functional checks and Central STABLE heartbeats pass; verification scopes [false, true]
measures.pass_fail: PASS if recovery verification passed before ROLLED_BACK

measures.title: Application IPC sockets and units do not weaken the existing privilege boundaries
measures.method: socket mode, special-file refusal, unit hardening, group-only reachability
measures.expected: sockets 0660; non-socket paths never deleted; apps run as their own accounts with existing hardening; snapshot drops root via setpriv
measures.pass_fail: PASS if no privilege is widened

measures.title: The Central application ships as a reproducible slot payload
measures.method: payload script and launcher tests
measures.expected: bin/central-control + lib/central_control.py, refuses non-empty output, module runs
measures.pass_fail: PASS if the payload matches the sources
